question: Does a lender looking at my credit report lower my score?
rubric: Distinguishes hard pulls (lower score) from soft pulls (no effect)

in_pack_facts.fact: Soft pull does not affect score

in_pack_facts.fact: Similar hard pulls in a window count once
in_pack_facts.quote: Similar type hard pulls in a certain time window will only count once, because it is assume you are shopping.
